$comment: English texts of data/party-events.json (src/engine/overlay.js): every party event with its options and outcomes, and the texts around them.

texts.leaderNote: You decide for the whole party: {names}.
texts.waiting: Party event: {title}. The leader ({leader}) chooses. The result comes in a separate report, at the latest 12 hours after the trip ends.
texts.chosen: Party event: {title}. The leader's ({leader}) choice: {option}. The result is in a separate report in the Journal.
texts.auto: Party event: {title}. The leader did not choose within 12 hours, so the party took the safest way: {option}. The result is in a separate report in the Journal.
texts.reportAuto: The leader did not choose within 12 hours, so the party took the safest way: {option}.
texts.busyHp: The wounds will heal on the way, as the character is already busy with something else.
texts.fainted: The party loses the fight. Everyone gets away alive, but with little strength left.
texts.draw: The fight has no winner. The party falls back with no loot.
texts.bagFull: There was no room in the bag for: {lost}.

rope-bridge.title: Rope Bridge
rope-bridge.text: A chasm cuts across the path, and an old rope bridge sways above it. The planks creak, the ropes are frayed.

one-by-one.label: We cross one at a time

outcome.text: You cross one at a time, slowly, plank by plank. The bridge creaks but holds, and every step above the chasm teaches something (+{xp} XP).

across.name: Run: they make it
across.text: You run across together before the bridge can change its mind. The time saved stays in your legs: the party's next trip will be 10% shorter.

breaks.name: Run: the bridge gives way
breaks.text: Halfway across a rope snaps. The party flies over the last planks and lands on the rocks on the other side. Everyone loses 15% of their health.

cache.name: Ford: a smugglers' cache
cache.text: The ford leads to a cave by the water, and in it lies a smugglers' cache. Everyone takes gold (+{gold} gold).

nowhere.name: Ford: leads nowhere
nowhere.text: You look for a ford until dusk, but the river never gets shallow. In the end you cross the bridge one at a time, tired and empty-handed.

smugglers-camp.title: Smugglers' Camp
smugglers-camp.text: At dusk the party sees a campfire. Smugglers sleep around it, and next to them stand crates of goods.

outcome.text: The party bursts into the camp, weapons drawn.
outcome.start: The smugglers leap up from the fire: {enemies}.

win.text: Among the goods are gold and materials. Everyone takes a share: {materials}.

lose.text: The smugglers defend their goods fiercely. The party falls back into the forest.

sneak.label: We sneak in for a crate

loot.name: Crate: potions and herbs

herbsKnown.goldText: The crate opens without a creak. Inside are potions and a purse. Everyone takes a share: {potions} and gold (+{gold} gold).

loot.text: The crate opens without a creak. Inside are potions and herbs, and everyone takes a share: {potions}, {herbs}.

wake.name: Crate: the smugglers wake up
wake.text: A twig snaps under someone's boot. The smugglers wake with weapons in hand.

win.text: The smugglers flee into the forest, and the party shares the gold from their purses.

lose.text: The smugglers chase the party away from their crates.

outcome.text: The party goes around the camp in a wide arc. The fire fades behind your backs, and nobody even noticed you were there.

wounded-hunter.title: Wounded Hunter
wounded-hunter.text: A wounded hunter of the Hunters' Brotherhood sits under a tree and asks for help.

escort.label: We walk him to the settlement

outcome.text: The party walks the hunter to the settlement. The Hunters' Brotherhood will not forget this favour, and the hunter shares with everyone what he had in his pouch (+{gold} gold, +15 reputation with the Hunters' Brotherhood).
The leader gives the hunter a healing potion. The hunter gets back on his feet on his own and promises to tell the Brotherhood about you (+30 reputation with the Hunters' Brotherhood).
The party moves on. The hunter watches you go and says nothing more.

campfire-tales.title: Campfire Tales
campfire-tales.text: At a halt someone in the party starts telling stories of old trips, and nobody wants to go to sleep.

outcome.text: The tales go on until dawn. Everyone remembers something useful for the road: on the party's next trip everyone will earn 10% more XP.
Everyone adds a story, and the best of them reveal where loot is worth looking for: on the party's next trip everyone will earn 10% more gold.

buried-chest.title: Buried Chest
buried-chest.text: Under the root of an old oak the party digs up a chest. Inside are gold and one shining stone.

outcome.text: You share the gold equally, and the stone stays in the chest for the next lucky ones (+{gold} gold).

leader.text: The stone goes to you: {minerals}. The rest of the party shares the gold.

others.text: The stone goes to the leader, and the rest share the gold among themselves (+{gold} gold).

plain.name: Chest: an ordinary one
plain.text: It is just a chest. At the bottom, under the gold, lie more stones, so everyone gets gold and a mineral (+{gold} gold, {minerals}).

mimic.name: Chest: a mimic
mimic.text: The lid twitches, and yellow eyes peer out from under the gold. It is a mimic!
mimic.start: The mimic lunges at the party: {enemies}.

win.text: Gold it swallowed over the years pours out of the beaten mimic. Everyone grabs a handful.

lose.text: The mimic snaps its lid shut and buries itself under the oak again.
